title: koanophyllon bullescens
intro: Koanophyllon bullescens, commonly known as Bulle's tree, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's health benefits include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may help to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities.
